trust_boundary: Authenticated service controls subject admission, scopes, audience, clock, broker host and public key set. Models and client JSON do not call store admission methods directly.

storage.engine: local SQLite WAL, synchronous FULL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE
storage.revocation_state: terminal; never evicted to admit more work
storage.policy_change: explicit migration required for issuer, scope allowlist or token TTL policy

attestation.nonce: 32 random bytes, only SHA-256 stored, single-use atomic enrollment
attestation.accepted_verdict: exact field set, boolean true, bounded freshness and trusted broker receipt; never user-authored verified flags
attestation.verifier_implementation_boundary: HTTPS broker must actually verify Android/Apple evidence; this client does not replace those platform verifiers

token.format: canonical JSON JWS-shaped HGAT2 envelope; not advertised as generic JWT interoperability
token.encoding: canonical unpadded base64url; duplicate/nonfinite JSON rejected
token.verification: Pinned immutable public Ed25519 SPKI set, current key validity, actual OpenSSL signature check, then exact durable claims and authority recheck
token.signing_commit: prepared metadata before broker call; signature verification before fenced active commit; exceptions retain non-active state
token.key_storage: Public DER only; no local production signing keys
token.temporary_verification_material: sealed Linux anonymous memory descriptors; no disk fallback
token.execution_authority: Authentication does not replace final edge policy, exact decision leases, consent or device effect authorization

broker.configuration: protected HTTPS endpoint, exact expected hostname and workload-token callback
broker.tls: system default certificate verification and hostname checking; no caller TLS context
broker.late_call: worker retains permit; late return does not commit local authority
broker.errors: redacted stable codes; response bodies and workload credentials are not logged

recovery.prepared_or_indeterminate_token: Never promoted after restart; revoke old token ID and issue a fresh one under current authority
recovery.device: Ordinary registration cannot revive a revoked device or replace a bound proof; step-up lost-device replacement workflow remains OPEN
recovery.fanout: Monotonic persistent revocation events; external consumers must persist cursor and apply idempotently
recovery.backup: No stale database restore into active service; forward repair and revocation reconciliation required

remaining: Real KMS/HSM and Android/Apple verifier behind the broker
Authenticated account/recovery service and step-up device replacement
Cross-service live-session revoke consumers and witnessed deployment drills
evidence_ceiling: Repository implementation and synthetic signature/transport tests only; not live platform, provider, independent review or release evidence
